key_findings.advertising_strategy_notes: Gymshark employs a comprehensive multi-platform advertising approach with heavy emphasis on paid search (Google, Bing), social media advertising (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), and sophisticated data infrastructure (mParticle as CDP). The presence of Dynamic Yield indicates focus on personalized customer experiences. Mobile marketing via AppLovin suggests mobile app user acquisition strategy. Affiliate programs running through Rakuten and Amazon.
key_findings.relative_platform_investment: Unable to determine relative spend or ad volume due to ad library access restrictions. All platforms show active implementation via cookies/pixels, suggesting ongoing campaigns across all channels.

notes: Research conducted via privacy policy and cookie policy documentation due to access restrictions on primary research tools (BuiltWith, ad libraries, main website). All platforms listed have verified technical implementation via cookies or explicit privacy policy mentions. The actual ad volume and campaign details could not be verified due to access limitations on ad transparency tools. Gymshark appears to use a sophisticated martech stack with centralized data collection (mParticle) feeding multiple advertising and personalization platforms.
